name: becise
description: Rebuild any chart from any source (slide, PDF, dashboard, screenshot) via the Becise MCP, show it live, and place it into Slides/Docs or export as PNG. Orchestrates slide-revision-v2: always ask the human to lock job/claim before critique (no Drive/email search), always get consent on the raw critique before slide_revision_build. Bundles becise-chart, becise-place, becise-story-enrichment, and becise-slide-revision-v2.
